grammar.summary: 本课学习一般过去时的规则/不规则动词与 spend/waste 时间表达。

points.title: 一般过去时规则动词
points.explanation: 加 -ed：visit→visited, decide→decided。否定 didn't + 原形。叙述过去经历全用过去时。

examples.en: I visited museums and sat in public gardens.
examples.cn: 我参观博物馆，坐在公园里。

points.title: 动词 + 宾语 + 宾补结构（keep/make）
points.explanation: kept me busy / made me feel... 表"使某人处于某状态"。

examples.en: Every day I thought about postcards.
examples.cn: 我每天都想着明信片的事。

exercises.q: Mary and I ___ (talk) about your book hours ago.
Tom ___ (be) a student when he was ten years old.
